decision.instrumentation: Stop this diagnostic route; no further collector expansion or acquisition to chase the missing service owner.
decision.runtimeClaim: No runtime optimization or accepted performance gain is established.
decision.nextControlledContrast: Parent authorizes one six-action uninstrumented control versus exact previous row-isolation CSS on the same acd4339 baseline, fresh browser per role. Current immediate ON scheduling differs from the prior ec0 deferred ON experiment, so that prior rejection is not a matched causal test of this schedule. Stable list ownership supports the hypothesis, not a claim that list owns31ms service. If warm benefit is absent, reject again and stop.
decision.quality: No backdrop/antialiasing/resolution/density changes. Old optical evidence is scoped to its original mounted case; current right-rail/layout differences prevent blanket visual equivalence.

limitations: Diagnostic tracing and LayerTree change timings; no performance credit.
Reported layer owner is the first paint-chunk client owner, not exclusive ownership of shared layer content.
Canonical IDs are same captured process/page; attribution requires unchanged backend in every recorded epoch.
Host-receipt timestamps are not trace times; node attributes/reasons are resolved after capture.
Worker task sums can overlap, and service spans nest; neither is hardware GPU duration.
GPU-service-to-layer attribution requires an actual emitted flow/command bridge; temporal overlap is insufficient.
